summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload in SVG-illustrations package
details: @servicetitan/anvil2-illustrations@1.0.2 declares itself as an SVG illustration set (package.json files allowlist: illustrations/*.svg and CHANGELOG.md) but ships two undeclared files in the tarball: setup.mjs and math_init.js. The package.json preinstall script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, chmods it executable, and invokes `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'])`. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscated blob using a rotated string-array decoder (WV8StW) with a large mixed constant table and hex-mangled identifiers; the filename (math_init) does not correspond to its contents and it is not listed in the package's files manifest. Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime and using it to execute a bundled obfuscated payload at install time is an alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that bypasses Node-focused install-time scanners. The @servicetitan/* scope also mirrors ServiceTitan's real anvil2 UI package family, consistent with a scope-impersonation squat.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
